newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dragages wins $149 mln contracts in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Dragages wins $149 mln contracts in Asia.

text.p: Dragages et Travaux Publics said on Friday it has won contracts in Singapore and Indonesia worth a total of US$149 million.

Dragages et Travaux said in a statement it had been appointed by Singapore developer Hong Leong Holdings for the design and construction of the Hazel Park condominium in Singapore, which was worth US$119 million.

Its Indonesian arm, PT Dragages Indonesia, was appointed main contractor in a joint venture with local construction company Total Bangun Persada by PT Bentala Mahaya for phase one of the Kota Kasablanca development in central Jakarta, it said.
The contract was worth US$30 million, it said.
Both PT Dragages Indonesia and Dragages et Travaux are part of Paris-based construction conglomerate Bouygues Group, which has its Asian headquarters in Hong Kong.
